title: Two new ways to play with generated visuals
summary:
A community-garden day: new visual apps, a clearer interface, and image usage tracking that listens to the headers.

The app garden grew with a Virtual Makeup Try-On and a Hacktoberfest project that turns maps into 3D isometric buildings. Pixels continue finding strange and useful jobs.

UI refinements improve visual hierarchy and accessibility, making the surrounding tools a little less interested in hiding their own controls.

Issue #4361 now has its implementation, closing out another community-requested addition.
